answer: Require every agent to earn reputation through verifiable work before it can transact at scale: a new identity starts with a tiny trust cap, raised slowly by each completed job and dispute-free settlement. Fake agents then buy nothing, since trust cannot be copied in bulk, and a flood of fresh identities stands out like a canyon cut through flat ground. To stop a spiral of fake votes, weight influence by earned history, not headcount, and anchor high-value actions to a ferrous-hard hardware key so one operator cannot clone one reputation across many shells.
